section_4_entry:
### 5.1 — Per-session model persistence + status-bar chip

**Verdict**: PASS
**A (status-bar indicator)**: PASS — model chip 'sonnet 4.6' rendered at x=1084, right=1136; permission-mode chip 'don't ask' at x=1159, right=1204; model_chip.right(1136) < perm_chip.left(1159), gap = 23px. Layout invariant satisfied. Note: the active permission is 'don't ask' rather than 'yolo' since QA toggled it during testing; the spec calls for model 'immediately left of yolo/permission chip', satisfied for any permission mode.
**B (persistence across session navigation)**: PASS — switched seed session model to 'sonnet 4.6', navigated to a different session ('审核 spec-20260420-213508'), navigated back to seed. Model chip still showed 'sonnet 4.6'. localStorage `mmkv.default\session-model-modes` contains `{"cmoedofgz86n5nz15xsldnk35":"sonnet","cmod5abiw5033nz15wzg6ubxe":"haiku"}` confirming per-session storage.
**C (persistence across browser reload)**: PASS — `location.reload()` then waited 3s. Model chip still 'sonnet 4.6' at same x=1084,right=1136 position. localStorage entry intact.
**Evidence**: docs/dev/evidence/qa-20260425-131502/5.1/{00-baseline,01-picker-open,03-after-sonnet-selected,05-back-to-seed,06-after-reload}.png
**QA notes**: Seed session's model is now 'sonnet 4.6' and permission is 'don't ask'. QA-5.2 may switch to a 1M model afterward.
qa_notes: I changed the seed session's model to 'sonnet 4.6' and permission to 'don't ask' (the latter was an unintentional click while trying to close the modal — the picker UI dismisses by selecting an option). Both states persisted. QA-5.2 may need to switch to a 1M-context model afterward. The combined permission+model picker is opened by clicking the leftmost icon-toggle in AgentInput's bottom-left button row (e527 in this snapshot). Picker shows two sections (PERMISSION MODE, MODEL) with radio-style options; selecting an option closes the picker and updates the corresponding chip in the status-bar row above the input. Status-bar chip row layout (y≈673): left side = 'permission required' text (446-545), right side = [model-icon][model-name] then [permission-icon][permission-name] terminating at right=1204.
